objective: Determine whether a generated illustration retains the reference optical-instrument wiring guide's communication value.
scope: Compare exact supplied guide and candidate visually; independent evaluation based on visible evidence.

criteria.endpoints: Each source and destination visible in the guide remains identifiable and each signal meets the intended port in the candidate.
criteria.labels: Read all guide titles, device, port and signal labels; flag omissions, substitutions, ambiguous attachment or illegibility.
criteria.routes: Trace each entire signal path and compare its ordering, orthogonal bend pattern and relation to other signals, allowing stylistic changes and global scale.
criteria.false_connections: Look explicitly for branches, extra circuits, dot junctions, wires merging, and extra connectors that alter how a reader interprets the source diagram.
criteria.readability: Inspect contrast, crowding, legibility at native size, and overlap between wires, labels and panel edges.

reporting: Locate each observation by named target and approximate native pixel region. Mark an obscured or ambiguous critical relationship as unverifiable. Do not infer source values from generated text. No quantitative pixel registration claim without a corresponding measurement.
